scope: Actual Android HTTP lifecycle regression iteration, not a full cycle or push receipt

new_assertions: Cancellation before headers closes the actual socket and leaves the caller cancelled.
Cancellation of a blocked body read closes the socket and joins the IO child without surfacing an unrelated failure.
The real call deadline still produces IO failure after headers while the body is blocked.
HTTPS sends a TLS handshake and rejects a plaintext response rather than downgrading.

whole_app.validation: Complete reports retained before parsing; every size and SHA-256 independently checked.

reproduced_before_fix.first_failure: Blocked-body cancellation raised IllegalStateException: Unbalanced enter/exit on API31 and API37.
reproduced_before_fix.second_failure: After removing concurrent response closure, socket IO failure still overrode cancellation on both APIs.
reproduced_before_fix.repair: Cancel the call to interrupt the socket, join the owned reader before closing the response, and preserve cancellation when IO fails in a cancelled reader while retaining active IO failures.
